title: Governing Enterprise AI Traffic at Scale: Design and Operation of a Policy-Driven, Multi-Vendor LLM Gateway on Envoy
title_zh: 大规模治理企业AI流量：基于Envoy的策略驱动多厂商LLM网关的设计与运营

paragraphs.en: PayPal基于Envoy的LLM网关治理多厂商流量，日处理约2000亿令牌且仅增加中位数4毫秒延迟。 Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evaluated by Open Policy Agent and managed through a control plane with role-scoped authoring, approvals, pilots, shadow-mode rollout, usage notifications and versioned policy bundles. For use cases that require it, a data-loss-prevention layer can block, redact or pseudonymize detected sensitive content before it reaches a provider. Spend scopes are views over per-model usage counters, so a new budget applies to spend already recorded in its window without migration. As of September 2026, the gateway serves more than 12,000 developers and hundreds of business use cases, handling roughly 200 billion tokens per day across more than 100 models at 99.999% availability to business. In a benchmark of the core request path against a synthetic upstream, it adds a median of 4 ms and a p99 of 11 ms of overhead at more than 2,200 requests per second on two 4-vCPU instances. We report the architecture, policy model, evaluation and lessons learned.
paragraphs.zh: PayPal基于Envoy的LLM网关治理多厂商流量，日处理约2000亿令牌且仅增加中位数4毫秒延迟。大型企业同时从多家供应商消费大语言模型（LLM），而每家供应商都有各自的API方言、凭证模式、流式协议和定价方式。 如果直接集成，这种异构性会导致凭证泛滥、格式锁定、开支失控以及治理不一致。 我们介绍了Cosmos LLM网关的设计与生产运维情况，它是PayPal企业级LLM流量的受治理入口。 该网关构建于Envoy之上，按延迟特征划分工作：受I/O约束的控制决策（身份验证、凭证代理、策略与预算评估）在进程外的外部处理服务中运行，而传输格式转换、令牌计量和提示缓存整形则以Rust WebAssembly过滤器的形式在代理内运行，因此默认情况下，流式响应体分块永远不会因进程外调用而阻塞等待。 模型、供应商和价格在很大程度上是经过验证的数据，而非代码。 治理是由Open Policy Agent评估的声明式策略，并通过一个控制平面进行管理，该控制平面支持基于角色的策略编写、审批、试点、影子模式发布、使用通知以及带版本的策略包。 对于有此类需求的用例，数据防泄漏层可以在敏感内容到达供应商之前对其进行拦截、脱敏或假名化。 开支范围是基于各模型用量计数器的视图，因此新预算可以覆盖其时间窗口内已记录的开支，而无需迁移。 截至2026年9月，该网关服务超过12,000名开发者和数百个业务用例，每天在100多个模型上处理约2000亿令牌，面向业务的可用性达99.999%。 在针对合成上游的核心请求路径基准测试中，该网关在两个4 vCPU实例上以每秒超过2,200个请求的速率运行时，仅增加中位数4毫秒、p99为11毫秒的开销。 我们报告了其架构、策略模型、评估结果以及经验教训。
